name: tags-input
title: Tags Input
description: An input that keeps chosen skills as removable blue pills. You type in the field and press Enter or comma to add one; clicking a pill loads it back into the field to edit.
use: People need to enter several short labels, such as skills or keywords, in one field.
avoid: Duplicate tags are silently ignored and there is no autocomplete, so long lists get tedious.
a11y: Tags are clickable divs rather than buttons, so keyboard users cannot start editing, and the crosses lack names. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered rounded box on a dark page holds a row of small blue pills with white text and a white cross on each. Below them, inside the same box, sits a dark text field reading Add a tag...; a muted Skills label and hint sit outside.
behaves: Typing and pressing Enter or comma adds the text as a new pill and clears the field, unless the tag already exists. Clicking a pill swaps it for an editable field, and blurring or pressing Enter saves the change; each cross removes its pill.
customise: Pass tags and setTags to control the list, and editTag to allow inline editing. Colours and pill shapes come from classes in the source.
weight: light: A few text pills and two inputs with no animation loop.
